comment: CitB is a cytochrome P450 monooxygenase that catalyzes the formation biaryl and aryl-oxygen-aryl ether bonds in the core tetrapeptide (YIYY)

reactions.description: CitB catalyzes the oxidative formation of C–C and C–O cross-links within the CitA precursor peptide and MxPep is responsible for maturation of the peptide by removing the leader sequence generating the intermediate product cittilin B.
